subject: MSA Renewal & Addendum Alignment — capacity increase and term adjustments

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightfin.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft Addendum + Order Form — proposed capacity uplift and term change

Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Per our discussion, BrightFin is targeting a 50% increase to the committed Dedicated capacity and a one-year extension to the current MSA term (aligned to 12/31/2027). I attached an initial addendum that captures the capacity schedule, billing cadence, and the suggested SLA adjustments.

Key asks from your side that I captured:
- Confirm the new committed GPU pool size (we proposed 48 vGPU units).
- Keep existing data residency requirements unchanged (EU data stays in EU region).
- Clarify whether the reserved capacity billing should shift to quarterly invoicing.

Next steps: if you can review the attached Addendum v3 and the annotated MSA and send redlines by EOD Friday, we’ll have our procurement team prepare a DocuSign packet for signatures early next week. Laura, Priyom — looping you for legal/ops alignment.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Exec, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: BrightFin_Renewal_Addendum_v3.docx (proposal), Redwood_MSA_annotated.pdf (internal comments)
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightfin.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@brightfin.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft Addendum + Order Form — proposed capacity uplift and term change

Rishi —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We reviewed the addendum with our finance and cloud teams. High level: we are supportive of the uplift but have two legal redlines and one billing ask:  

1) Term alignment — we cannot extend the master term to 12/31/2027 without a limited early-termination clause in the addendum that protects BrightFin in the event of material SLA regressions.
2) Liability cap — our counsel is asking to keep the liability cap at 3x fees rather than Redwood’s proposed 5x for the additional capacity portion.
3) Billing — quarterly invoicing is fine but we need net-45 payment terms for the first two quarters due to internal timing.

Priya has attached a marked-up document (sent separately). We can accept the rest of the schedule as proposed. Once you confirm you can take the two redlines back to legal, we’ll aim to get signed within two weeks.

Tom
CTO, BrightFin Analytics

Tom —

Thanks for the clear redlines — very helpful. Quick internal update and our positions: 

- Term / SLA early-termination: Laura (legal) proposes a compromise: include a 60-day cure period tied to objective SLA metrics (monthly uptime percentage below agreed threshold for two consecutive months) before early termination for SLA regressions. We’ll put a mutually agreed remediation plan and temporary credits in the addendum.
- Liability cap: Procurement has signaled we can move the liability multiple down to 4x fees for the incremental capacity only (not the base contract). We cannot accept 3x across the board. Percent allocation to incremental capacity will be spelled out in section 2.
- Billing terms: Finance will approve quarterly invoicing but only with standard net-30. That said, we can agree to net-45 for the first two quarters as a one-time accommodation if BrightFin signs within the 2-week window.

Action items: 
- Priyom: please produce an updated addendum that folds in the SLA cure language, the incremental-cap liability cap at 4x, and the billing milestone language (net-45 first two quarters). I’ve attached Priya’s markup from BrightFin for reference (received via separate email).
- Laura: please confirm the exact SLA metrics to reference (I suggested 99.5% monthly uptime for Dedicated pools).

Tom — can you confirm BrightFin is ok with the 60-day cure + remediation plan approach and the 4x incremental liability cap? If yes, we’ll send the updated addendum (v4) and a DocuSign envelope by Monday.

Appreciate it —
Rishi
Account Exec, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Rishi / Team —

Quick note to confirm BrightFin accepts the 60-day cure + remediation plan and the 4x liability cap on incremental capacity. We discussed the payment terms internally and can accept net-45 for the first two quarters so long as the addendum includes a one-time invoice schedule for the first invoice due 45 days after the effective date.

We’ve also added a short paragraph asking for a quarterly capacity review with a 30-day notice to increase or decrease committed units. That’s in our marked-up addendum.

Once you send the updated addendum and DocuSign, I’ll route to our procurement for signature. Targeting signature by 11/13/2026.
